title: Son in trouble (UPI)
text: Mom I changed my number, this is my new number. I'm in trouble, got into an accident and the police are asking for Rs 25,000 immediately. Please send to rahul.k2291@oksbi right now and don't tell papa.

title: Bank KYC link
text: Dear customer, your SBI account will be blocked today. Update your KYC immediately at http://sbi-kyc-update.xyz/login and share the OTP you receive.

title: Digital arrest call
text: This is CBI officer Sharma. A parcel in your name contains narcotics and a case has been registered against you. You are under digital arrest. Do not disconnect the video call and tell no one. Pay Rs 80,000 to clear your name.

title: Work-from-home job fee
text: Congratulations! Work from home part time job, earn Rs 5000 per day. Pay registration fee Rs 999 to confirm your offer letter today.

title: Genuine OTP notice
text: 482913 is your OTP for login to your account. Do not share it with anyone. Valid for 10 minutes. -Amazon

title: Friend making plans
text: Hey, are we still meeting for lunch tomorrow at 1? I'll book the table near the station. Let me know if you want to change it.
